question: Evidence gathered for the untested untyped-scaffold mechanism on F_b011_s030. conditional_layout on F_b011_s030__G21 returned a fixed-geometry legal-layout enumeration (10 measured layouts, native N site 22, native_minus_alternate_mean 0.0763, single N->N exchanges spanning delta_score -0.441 to +0.207, n_identifiable_interactions 0) — this is a label-swap head-score response, not a coordinate-intervention effect, and it does not establish a beneficial local displacement. regional_context on F_b011_s030__G06 returned the untyped spatial contrast (atom_slots [0,2,3,6,13,17,21,22], bulk_translation_A [0.027,-0.049,0.063], standardized_contrast_norm 1.61, n_controls 40 same-root dependent controls) plus pocket fields whose roles are labeled O_acceptor/N_acceptor but whose distances are geometric only, not interaction energies. regional_trajectories on F_b011_s030__G21 gave retrospective historical-Steer fits (ancestor vs contrast curves over [0.0,0.5], e.g. signed_dy_A ancestor net_rate 0.756 vs contrast net_rate -0.054) explicitly flagged as not current guidance and not spatial reward gradients. control_response on F_b011_s030__G06 returned no matching parents, only the active-incumbent S0_REFERENCE_REPLAY context (40 active updates, mean point_rms_A 0.169, mean target_error 0.169), which is not a substitute for a region-matched parent response. Net: the untyped G21/G06 supports are distinguishable from the tested NC/O/NO/N22 role-typed supports only as descriptive geometry contrasts; no measured evidence yet shows that a from-zero pointwise intervention on an untyped scaffold region would avoid the repeated geometry-imitation tail loss (R03, R04, R05, R07, R08_v2, R09_v2, R11_v2, R13_v2 all lower tail than reference). The discriminating from-zero experiment — one principal intervention, pointwise operator on F_b011_s030__G21, same prior and RNG, single factor — remains untested and is the appropriate next step; its falsifier is a tail not exceeding the reference replay. Claims above are measured (tool returns) or proposed (the untested experiment); no terminal-benefit claim is made.
